title: Octopus waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Octopus body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='24' ry='26' fill='#c85fa8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='20' ry='20' fill='#e07cc0'/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='30' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f2a8dd' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='6' fill='#fff8f0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='44' r='6' fill='#fff8f0'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='45' r='3' fill='#3a1030'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='45' r='3' fill='#3a1030'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='44' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='44' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='53' r='3' fill='#f0a0c8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='53' r='3' fill='#f0a0c8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M45 56 Q50 61 55 56' stroke='#7a2050' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Tentacles -->
  <!-- Left resting tentacles -->
  <path d='M30 60 Q22 72 26 82 Q30 90 22 90' stroke='#c85fa8' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M38 66 Q32 78 36 86 Q40 92 33 94' stroke='#d46cb0' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M46 68 Q44 80 48 88' stroke='#c85fa8' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Right resting tentacles -->
  <path d='M54 68 Q56 80 52 88' stroke='#c85fa8' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 66 Q68 78 64 86 Q60 92 67 94' stroke='#d46cb0' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 60 Q78 70 74 78' stroke='#c85fa8' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Waving tentacle (raised, right side) -->
  <path d='M74 40 Q84 30 86 20 Q88 12 82 10' stroke='#d46cb0' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Wave ticks -->
  <path d='M92 14 L96 12' stroke='#f2a8dd' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M90 20 L95 20' stroke='#f2a8dd' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
